newsitem.title: JAPAN: Maruha Corp up in morning on dividend news.
newsitem.headline: Maruha Corp up in morning on dividend news.

text.p: Maruha Corp shares were higher in Tuesday morning trade, encouraged by the firm's announcement on the previous day that it would pay an ordinary dividend of three yen, brokers said.
As of 0126 GMT, shares of the marine food products firm were up 25 yen at 285. It was the second-largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
"There are some investors who are buying the shares for the dividend, while others are attracted by the volatility of the shares," a broker at a mid-sized brokerage said.
